audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN 5.5/10 understates a 55.27% win rate over 1965 games, and the page repeatedly told you to poke 'while his Q shield is down' — implying Null Sphere blunts your trades. It cannot.
audit.why: Riot Q text: 'The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Zed's Q, E and R are physical; only his passive Contempt for the Weak is magic. So the shield and Void Stone's magic reduction touch almost nothing of your combo.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeGood, breakdown.early, phases[2].why, whys[1], spikes[0].text and early now state that the shield absorbs magic while your combo is physical. Left diffRating alone rather than move a rating without a mirror to check it against.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Zed,Zed,Zed,Skill,Zed,Skill,Kassadin while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Zed on all seven rows. Rows 3, 5 and 6 disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Kassadin has no wave clear before Force Pulse and no escape before Riftwalk, so 4-5 is Zed's. Zed's lethality item lands well before Rod of Ages. Row 6 ('2+ items') is still Zed's closing window per both the content why and spikes[3].text — Kassadin's takeover is full build, past this row.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side Skill->Zed, phases[5].side Skill->Zed, phases[6].side Kassadin->Zed as one atomic group, with phases[3].why, [5].why and [6].why rewritten in the same proposal to state the verdict. No win[N] edits: the content layer already read Zed on every row and a no-op would have voided the group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions were absent. (a) Force Pulse charges from spells cast in Kassadin's vicinity — your own poke arms his cone. (b) Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up, not a cast, is the burst tell.
audit.why: Riot E text: 'Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity.' Riot W text: 'Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage', flagged autoReset, 7s cooldown. Force Pulse is 21/20/19/18/17s, 400 range, and slows.
audit.corrected: tradeBad and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the Force Pulse charging mechanic with its 21s cooldown; dontsFull[2].d carries the Nether Blade 7s reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and dosFull[2].d invited you to 'take the fifteen-second invitation' off a whiffed Riftwalk.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds, not fifteen. It is never meaningfully down late — the real cost is mana, which climbs on each recast within a short period.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both with the real numbers and pointed the punish at the escalating mana cost instead of a cooldown that does not exist.
